card.text: Orcus is a large resonant world beyond Neptune, partnered with the substantial moon Vanth. The displayed size belongs to Orcus alone; its smooth shape and grid surface are illustrative.

model.title: Published size model; shape unresolved
model.summary: Size-constrained spherical illustration at Orcus’s primary-only thermal diameter, 910 +50/−40 km. ALMA separated the binary components but did not resolve Orcus’s terrain or measure three shape axes. Illustrative ICRF north pole (RA 0°, Dec +90°), arbitrary prime meridian and phase. No measured body pole or absolute surface attitude is claimed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
